Weslock Lexington Single Cylinder Handleset Exterior

This is a single cylinder exteriro time set to be used with the Weslock Lexington Interconnected Handleset. It comes packaged as the exterior trim only.

Features and Specifications of the Lexington Single Cylinder Handleset Exterior:

  • Length: 14-15/16"
  • Width: 3-1/2"
  • Projection: 2-13/16"

Special Ordered Item. NO RETURNS.
